description: Use this when you need to understand or schedule a 5-field cron expression. Prefer this over reasoning about cron semantics yourself (a documented LLM failure mode): it correctly handles ranges, lists, steps, month/day names, and the tricky day-of-month OR day-of-week rule. Deterministic: same input, same output. Returns a plain-English description, the expanded matching values per field, and the next run times computed in UTC (pass `now` to fix the reference point, `count` for how many). Example: '*/15 9-17 * * 1-5' -> description 'At minute */15 past hour 9-17 on every weekday (Monday through Friday)'.

count.description: How many upcoming run times to return (default 5).

expression.description: 5-field cron, e.g. "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5" (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week).

now.description: Optional ISO timestamp to compute next runs from (default: current time).

name: explain_cron

error.description: Always null on the success result.

nextRuns.description: Upcoming run times in UTC; length is capped by `count` (default 5).

iso.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the run.

label.description: Human-readable UTC label, e.g. 'Fri Jan 1 2027, 00:00 UTC'.

valid.description: Always true on the success result.

title: Cron Explainer
